title: BlindSpotMiner: an automated tool to surface prompts where ALL models fail together

original_idea.body: Search loop mutating prompts to amplify joint failure across N models; ranked universal-blind-spot list (arXiv:2606.00801).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: mining universal shared blind spots turns diffuse risk into concrete test cases.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: A mutation/search loop with joint-failure scoring needs solid engineering; intermediate.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Couples search loop, scoring, mutation, characterization; multi-workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent auditing tool labs won't build against themselves.

low_compute.reasoning: Search loop over cheap open models on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: QD-inspired; cross-model shared-failure mining may be partly open.
